records.name: Alcoholics Anonymous Southeastern Pennsylvania Intergroup Association
records.summary: The local service office for Alcoholics Anonymous groups in five southeastern Pennsylvania counties, Philadelphia included. Volunteer members answer a 24-hour help line and help newcomers find a meeting.
records.what_you_do: Call the help line to talk with a local member, or use the meeting finder on the website to pick a meeting. Members can also take service roles through the office.

schedule.text: The help line answers 24 hours a day, every day. Meeting times vary by group and are listed in the meeting finder.

locations.label: Intergroup office
locations.address: 1903 South Broad Street, 2nd Floor, Philadelphia, PA 19148

first_step.how: Call the 24-hour help line at 215-923-7900, or pick a meeting in the meeting finder and go to see what it is like.
first_step.basis: The site lists beginners' meetings and explains what to expect at a meeting, and its help line connects callers with a local member.

records.notes: Office email is not readable on the site (protected placeholder), so none is recorded. The home page lists a Spanish-language line at (215) 398-2540 that the contact page does not show; not recorded, verify before publishing. Office hours are not shown on the site. The home page gives two different years-in-service counts, so none is used. The meeting finder link sits in contacts.social because the record format has no meeting finder field. The newest dated item is a 2026 event with no month given, so last_sign_of_life is the year only.

records.name: Narcotics Anonymous Greater Philadelphia Region
records.summary: The regional service office for Narcotics Anonymous groups in the Philadelphia area. It runs phone lines for people who want to reach someone in recovery right away, and a line that gives meeting information by ZIP code.
records.what_you_do: Call for immediate help or for meeting information, or browse the meeting directory on the website by area, county, virtual meeting, or map. Members can also serve on regional committees such as hospitals and institutions, outreach, public relations, and the phone line.

schedule.text: Meetings run across the region, in person and online, at many different times. The meeting directory and the meeting information line have current times.

locations.label: Mailing address (not a meeting place)
locations.address: 150 Monument Rd, Suite 207-0026, Bala Cynwyd, PA 19004

first_step.how: Call 215-NA-WORKS for immediate help, or pick a meeting from the meeting directory on the website and go to see how it works.
first_step.basis: The site links a Welcome to NA page and an FAQ, and it says how to reach help and find a meeting.

records.notes: The Bala Cynwyd address is a mail drop (the site lists it under By U.S. Mail), not a meeting place. The site also lists a former mailing address in Cherry Hill, NJ with no date; not used. A second line, 215-999-4670 (call or text a ZIP code), is on the home page and is not the phone field here. Office hours are not published. An older directory listing from 2018 gave a Locust Street office; not used as it is outdated. The South Philly area has its own site at spa.naworks.org; it is one of the area committees under this region, so it is not recorded separately. The meeting directory link sits in contacts.social because the record format has no meeting finder field.

notes: Budget: all 3 WebSearch calls used; 18 fetches. Only 2 records are published, because the rest of the slice could not be verified with the sources available. (1) Al-Anon and Alateen: no Philadelphia office or intergroup could be confirmed. The Pennsylvania Al-Anon site is blocked to the fetch tool. The Pennsylvania PA 211 entries that did load cover northeastern counties, not Philadelphia. The national Al-Anon finder (https://al-anon.org/al-anon-meetings/find-an-al-anon-meeting/) and Alateen finder (https://al-anon.org/al-anon-meetings/find-an-alateen-meeting/) load, but they are not a Philadelphia office, so no record was written. Suggest a next-wave search for the Delaware Valley Al-Anon information service. (2) SMART Recovery: the national site (smartrecovery.org) loads and links a meeting finder at meetings.smartrecovery.org, which returned 403, so Philadelphia in-person meetings could not be confirmed. Dropped with this reason; no record. (3) PRO-ACT: proactphilly.org did not resolve (DNS error), and no URL for PRO-ACT or any other Philadelphia recovery community organization with peer groups or drop-in centers came up in three searches. Not searched: sober social groups, which need a next-wave search. The NA regional site and the SEPIA site were both checked, and their meeting directories were not copied. Note for the orchestrator: the contacts block has no meeting finder field, so both records put the finder link in contacts.social.
